items.title: Carmo do Paranaíba (MG) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #004
items.en_title: Carmo do Paranaíba (MG) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #004
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Carmo do Paranaíba (MG) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 51,930.80; proposals close Nov 27, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
